Blackout Poetry Maker

Paste any text, click words to black them out, and the surviving words become your poem.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste text into the box.
  2. Press Load text, then click words to black them out.
  3. Copy poem to grab the surviving words.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I black out words?

Click a word to black it out; click again to bring it back. Blacked-out words are hidden from the poem.

What order do poem words keep?

The poem keeps the original word order of every word you left visible.

Can I start over?

Press Reset to restore all blacked-out words, or load fresh source text any time.
